name: civicpulse-402
description: Autonomous Minnesota Municipal Compliance, Housing Code Violations, and Parcel GIS API Gateway powered by Base USDC x402 Micropayments (EIP-3009).
author: Keith Walter (kwizzlesurp10-ctrl)

tools.name: query_minneapolis_compliance
tools.description: Fetches real-time City of Minneapolis housing code violations, active repair orders, and building permits for a street address via ArcGIS Open Data. Costs 0.01 USDC on Base via x402.

address.description: Minneapolis street address (e.g., '1700 Penn Ave N')

tools.name: query_ramsey_parcel_audit
tools.description: Queries Ramsey County Open GIS for parcel attributes, registered owner, property use class, and tax assessment valuation by PIN or site address. Costs 0.01 USDC on Base via x402.
